stem: Which question is associated with the passage of the Espionage and Sedition Acts during World War I?

options.label: F
options.text: Should industries be allowed to prohibit workers from joining unions?

options.label: G
options.text: Can the government require citizens to purchase war bonds?

options.label: H
options.text: At what age should citizens be required to enlist in a branch of the military?

options.label: J
options.text: Can the government limit the constitutional rights of citizens during wartime?

visual_elements: Four answer options labeled F, G, H, J
